crossRefs.note: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”
Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.
The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So…
Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,
No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.
He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who…
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for…
Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by…
In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

translations.web: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
translations.bsb: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
translations.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
translations.asv: If I told you earthly things and ye believe not, how shall ye believe if I tell you heavenly things?
